rates.2019 Premium rates: The WSIB Maximum Insurable Earnings Ceiling for 2019 is $92,600, compared to $90,300 in 2018. Changes to the Maximum Insurable Earnings Ceiling are directly linked to changes in average earnings in Ontario as measured by Statistics Canada, and provisions under the Workplace Safety and Insurance Act.
